ko.title: 모든 경찰에게 카메라를, 모든 영상에 잠금장치를: ICE의 8월 말 바디캠 배포 내막

segments.src: ## A Long-Awaited Policy Reaches Its Deadline
segments.tr: ## 오래 기다려온 정책이 최종 기한에 도달하다

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: U.S.

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says that by the end of August, every field officer conducting arrests and enforcement operations will be equipped with a body-worn camera.
segments.tr: 이민 관세청(ICE)은 8월 말까지 체포 및 단속 작전을 수행하는 모든 현장 요원이 바디캠을 장착할 것이라고 밝혔다.

segments.src: The agency has described the rollout as a milestone for transparency and accountability, arriving after years of pressure from lawmakers, civil-liberties groups, and immigrant-rights advocates who have long argued that ICE operations were undertaken with too little independent documentation.
segments.tr: 해당 기관은 이 배포를 투명성과 책임성의 이정표로 설명했으며, ICE 작전이 너무 적은 독립적 기록으로 수행되었다고 오랫동안 주장해온 의원, 시민자유 단체, 이민자 권리 옹호자들의 수년 간의 압력 끝에 이루어졌다.

segments.src: According to agency statements, the initiative is meant to standardize how enforcement encounters are recorded, giving both officers and the public a consistent record of what happens during arrests, home visits, and transfers.
segments.tr: 기관의 성명에 따르면 이 계획은 단속 상황의 기록 방식을 표준화하여 경찰관과 일반인 모두에게 체포, 가택 방문, 이송 과정에서 일어나는 일에 대한 일관된 기록을 제공하려는 것이다.

segments.src: Supporters of the plan, including some members of Congress who have pushed for expanded oversight of federal law enforcement, have welcomed the expansion as a step toward greater public trust.
segments.tr: 연방 법 집행에 대한 감시 확대를 추진해온 의원 일부를 포함한 이 계획의 지지자들은 이번 확대를 공공 신뢰 증진을 위한 한 걸음으로 환영했다.

segments.src: ## The Provision Drawing Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## 면밀한 검토를 받고 있는 조항

segments.src: The rollout has not been without controversy.
segments.tr: 이 배포는 논란이 없지 않았다.

segments.src: Under the policy as described by ICE, footage from incidents involving officer-involved shootings or deaths in custody is not automatically released to the public or to families.
segments.tr: ICE가 설명한 정책에 따르면, 경찰관 총기 사용이나 구금 중 사망과 관련된 사건의 영상은 자동으로 일반인이나 유족에게 공개되지 않는다.

segments.src: Instead, agency leadership retains discretion over when — or whether — such footage is disclosed, a provision that can allow recordings to be withheld indefinitely while internal reviews are underway.
segments.tr: 대신 기관 지도부는 그러한 영상 공개 시기 및 공개 여부에 대한 재량권을 유지하며, 이는 내부 검토가 진행되는 동안 영상을 무기한 미공개할 수 있는 조항이다.

segments.src: That discretion has become the focal point of debate following two fatal encounters this summer, one in Maine and one in Houston, involving ICE personnel.
segments.tr: 그 재량권은 올여름 ICE 인원이 관여한 두 건의 치명적 사건(메인에서 한 건, 휴스턴에서 한 건)으로 인해 논쟁의 초점이 되었다.

segments.src: Details of both cases remain limited, and ICE has said that internal reviews are ongoing in accordance with standard procedure.
segments.tr: 두 사건 모두 세부 사항이 제한적이며, ICE는 표준 절차에 따라 내부 검토가 진행 중이라고 밝혔다.

segments.src: Family members and local advocacy organizations connected to the cases have called for the release of any existing body-camera footage, saying that timely disclosure is essential for public confidence in how such incidents are investigated.
segments.tr: 유족 및 해당 사건과 관련된 지역 옹호 단체들은 기존 바디캠 영상의 공개를 요청했으며, 적시의 공개가 이러한 사건이 어떻게 조사되는지에 대한 공공 신뢰에 필수적이라고 주장했다.

segments.src: Civil-liberties organizations, including groups that track use-of-force policies across federal agencies, argue that a body-camera program loses much of its accountability value if the agency being recorded also controls the release of the recordings.
segments.tr: 연방 기관 전반의 무력 사용 정책을 추적하는 단체들을 포함한 시민자유 단체들은 기록되는 기관이 영상 공개도 통제한다면 바디캠 프로그램이 많은 책임성 가치를 잃게 된다고 주장한다.

segments.src: "A camera that only the agency can choose to show us isn't oversight, it's a promise," one policy analyst focused on law-enforcement transparency told reporters, describing a concern echoed by several advocacy groups following the announcement.
segments.tr: "기관만 공개하기로 선택할 수 있는 카메라는 감시가 아니라 약속일 뿐이다"라고 법 집행 투명성에 초점을 맞춘 한 정책 분석가가 기자들에게 밝혔으며, 이는 발표 이후 여러 옹호 단체들이 반복한 우려를 나타낸다.

segments.src: ## How ICE's Approach Compares
segments.tr: ## ICE의 접근 방식 비교

segments.src: Body-camera policies vary widely across federal, state, and local law enforcement.
segments.tr: 바디캠 정책은 연방, 주(州), 지방 법 집행 기관 전반에 걸쳐 광범위하게 다양하다.

segments.src: Many police departments release footage of fatal encounters within a set number of days, sometimes under legal mandates passed after high-profile incidents involving other agencies.
segments.tr: 많은 경찰청이 일정 기간 내에 치명적 사건의 영상을 공개하며, 때로는 다른 기관의 고위험 사건 이후 통과된 법적 위임에 따른다.

segments.src: Federal agencies, including ICE, generally operate under different rules, often citing ongoing investigations, personnel privacy, and pending litigation as reasons for withholding footage for extended periods.
segments.tr: ICE를 포함한 연방 기관들은 일반적으로 다른 규칙에 따라 운영되며, 진행 중인 조사, 인원 개인정보 보호, 진행 중인 소송을 오랜 기간 영상을 미공개하는 이유로 자주 인용한다.

segments.src: Department of Homeland Security officials, of which ICE is a component, have previously said that footage from significant incidents is reviewed internally before any public release to ensure accuracy and to avoid compromising active investigations.
segments.tr: ICE가 한 부서인 국토안보부 관계자들은 이전에 중대 사건의 영상이 정확성을 보장하고 진행 중인 조사에 손상을 주지 않기 위해 모든 공개 이전에 내부적으로 검토된다고 말했다.

segments.src: Officials have also noted that footage may ultimately be shared with oversight bodies, courts, or families through formal channels even when it is not made public immediately.
segments.tr: 관계자들은 또한 영상이 즉시 공개되지 않는 경우에도 결국 공식 채널을 통해 감시 기관, 법원, 유족과 공유될 수 있다고 언급했다.

segments.src: ## What Advocates and Officials Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## 옹호자와 관계자들이 다음에 주목하는 것

segments.src: Lawmakers on relevant congressional committees have signaled interest in questioning ICE leadership about the disclosure timeline for footage tied to the Maine and Houston cases, according to statements from congressional offices following the incidents.
segments.tr: 해당 사건 이후 의회 사무소의 성명에 따르면 관련 의회 위원회 의원들은 메인과 휴스턴 사건과 관련된 영상의 공개 일정에 대해 ICE 지도부에 질문할 의사를 나타냈다.

segments.src: Whether that scrutiny leads to changes in the agency's release policy remains unclear.
segments.tr: 그 면밀한 검토가 기관의 공개 정책 변경으로 이어질지는 불분명하다.

segments.src: For now, ICE maintains that the camera rollout itself represents progress, regardless of the ongoing debate over disclosure rules.
segments.tr: 현재로서 ICE는 공개 규칙에 대한 진행 중인 논쟁과 무관하게 카메라 배포 자체가 진전을 나타낸다고 주장한다.

segments.src: Agency officials have framed the expansion as one part of a broader modernization effort that also includes updated training and reporting requirements for field officers.
segments.tr: 기관 관계자들은 이 확대를 현장 요원을 위한 업데이트된 훈련 및 보고 요구사항을 포함하는 광범위한 현대화 노력의 일부로 설명했다.

segments.src: Advocacy groups, meanwhile, say they will continue pressing for a binding timeline on footage release, arguing that cameras without a clear disclosure standard cannot fully deliver the accountability the program was designed to provide.
segments.tr: 한편 옹호 단체들은 명확한 공개 기준이 없는 카메라는 프로그램이 제공하도록 설계된 책임성을 완전히 전달할 수 없다고 주장하면서 영상 공개에 대한 구속력 있는 일정을 계속 요청할 것이라고 말한다.

segments.src: As the end-of-August deadline approaches, both supporters and critics of the policy agree on one point: how ICE handles footage from future incidents, not just whether cameras are worn, will determine whether the rollout meaningfully changes public trust in the agency's operations.
segments.tr: 8월 말 최종 기한이 다가올수록, 정책의 지지자와 비평가 모두 한 가지 점에 동의한다: 카메라 착용 여부뿐만 아니라 ICE가 향후 사건의 영상을 어떻게 처리하는지가 배포가 기관 운영에 대한 공공 신뢰를 의미 있게 변화시킬지를 결정할 것이라는 것이다.

segments.src: *This report reflects publicly available statements from ICE, congressional offices, and advocacy organizations as of publication.
segments.tr: *이 보도는 발행 당시 ICE, 의회 사무소, 옹호 단체들의 공개 성명을 반영한 것이다.

segments.src: Details of the Maine and Houston cases remain under review, and this article will be updated as verified information becomes available.*
segments.tr: 메인과 휴스턴 사건의 세부 사항은 검토 중이며, 검증된 정보가 제공되면 이 기사는 업데이트될 것이다.*

zh.title: 每个警官一部摄像机，每份录像加锁：ICE八月底执法摄像机推出内幕

segments.src: ## A Long-Awaited Policy Reaches Its Deadline
segments.tr: ## 期待已久的政策如期而至

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says that by the end of August, every field officer conducting arrests and enforcement operations will be equipped with a body-worn camera.
segments.tr: 移民和海关执法局表示，到八月底，所有执行逮捕和执法行动的外勤人员都将配备执法摄像机。

segments.src: The agency has described the rollout as a milestone for transparency and accountability, arriving after years of pressure from lawmakers, civil-liberties groups, and immigrant-rights advocates who have long argued that ICE operations were undertaken with too little independent documentation.
segments.tr: 该机构将此次推出描述为透明度和问责制的里程碑。这是在多年来来自议员、民权组织和移民权利倡导者的压力下才实现的。这些团体长期以来一直主张ICE的执法行动缺乏充分的独立文件记录。

segments.src: According to agency statements, the initiative is meant to standardize how enforcement encounters are recorded, giving both officers and the public a consistent record of what happens during arrests, home visits, and transfers.
segments.tr: 根据该机构的声明，该计划旨在规范执法接触的记录方式，为官员和公众提供一份关于逮捕、家访和人员转移期间发生情况的一致记录。

segments.src: Supporters of the plan, including some members of Congress who have pushed for expanded oversight of federal law enforcement, have welcomed the expansion as a step toward greater public trust.
segments.tr: 该计划的支持者，包括一些推动加强对联邦执法部门监督的国会议员，欢迎这一扩展，认为它是增进公众信任迈出的一步。

segments.src: ## The Provision Drawing Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## 引发审查的条款

segments.src: The rollout has not been without controversy.
segments.tr: 此次推出并非没有争议。

segments.src: Under the policy as described by ICE, footage from incidents involving officer-involved shootings or deaths in custody is not automatically released to the public or to families.
segments.tr: 根据ICE描述的政策，涉及警员开枪或拘留中死亡的事件录像不会自动向公众或受害者家属公开。

segments.src: Instead, agency leadership retains discretion over when — or whether — such footage is disclosed, a provision that can allow recordings to be withheld indefinitely while internal reviews are underway.
segments.tr: 相反，该机构领导层保留了何时以及是否披露此类录像的自由裁量权。这一条款允许在进行内部审查期间无限期地扣留录像。

segments.src: That discretion has become the focal point of debate following two fatal encounters this summer, one in Maine and one in Houston, involving ICE personnel.
segments.tr: 这种自由裁量权在今年夏天的两起致命事件后成为争论的焦点。一起发生在缅因州，一起发生在休斯敦，都涉及ICE人员。

segments.src: Details of both cases remain limited, and ICE has said that internal reviews are ongoing in accordance with standard procedure.
segments.tr: 两起案件的细节仍然有限。ICE表示正在按照标准程序进行内部审查。

segments.src: Family members and local advocacy organizations connected to the cases have called for the release of any existing body-camera footage, saying that timely disclosure is essential for public confidence in how such incidents are investigated.
segments.tr: 与这些案件相关的家庭成员和当地倡导组织呼吁公开任何现有的执法摄像机录像，声称及时披露对于维持公众对此类事件调查方式的信心至关重要。

segments.src: Civil-liberties organizations, including groups that track use-of-force policies across federal agencies, argue that a body-camera program loses much of its accountability value if the agency being recorded also controls the release of the recordings.
segments.tr: 民权组织，包括追踪联邦机构武力使用政策的组织，主张如果被监控的机构也控制录像的发布权，执法摄像机计划就会失去大部分问责价值。

segments.src: "A camera that only the agency can choose to show us isn't oversight, it's a promise," one policy analyst focused on law-enforcement transparency told reporters, describing a concern echoed by several advocacy groups following the announcement.
segments.tr: "一部只有该机构能选择向我们展示的摄像机不是监督，而是一种承诺，"一位专注于执法透明度的政策分析师告诉记者。在该机构公布这一政策后，几个倡导组织都提出了类似的关切。

segments.src: ## How ICE's Approach Compares
segments.tr: ## ICE的做法如何比较

segments.src: Body-camera policies vary widely across federal, state, and local law enforcement.
segments.tr: 身体摄像机政策在联邦、州和地方执法部门之间差异很大。

segments.src: Many police departments release footage of fatal encounters within a set number of days, sometimes under legal mandates passed after high-profile incidents involving other agencies.
segments.tr: 许多警察部门会在一定天数内公开致命接触事件的录像，有时是在高调事件涉及其他机构后通过法律授权实行的。

segments.src: Federal agencies, including ICE, generally operate under different rules, often citing ongoing investigations, personnel privacy, and pending litigation as reasons for withholding footage for extended periods.
segments.tr: 联邦机构，包括ICE，通常在不同的规则下运作。它们通常以进行中的调查、人员隐私和未决诉讼为借口，在较长时间内扣留录像。

segments.src: Department of Homeland Security officials, of which ICE is a component, have previously said that footage from significant incidents is reviewed internally before any public release to ensure accuracy and to avoid compromising active investigations.
segments.tr: 国土安全部官员（ICE是其下属部门）曾表示，来自重大事件的录像会经过内部审查后才向公众发布，以确保准确性并避免损害正在进行的调查。

segments.src: Officials have also noted that footage may ultimately be shared with oversight bodies, courts, or families through formal channels even when it is not made public immediately.
segments.tr: 官员们还指出，即使录像不立即向公众发布，最终也可能通过正式渠道与监督机构、法院或受害者家属分享。

segments.src: ## What Advocates and Officials Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## 倡导者和官员接下来关注的问题

segments.src: Lawmakers on relevant congressional committees have signaled interest in questioning ICE leadership about the disclosure timeline for footage tied to the Maine and Houston cases, according to statements from congressional offices following the incidents.
segments.tr: 根据事件后相关国会办公室发表的声明，相关国会委员会的议员已表示有兴趣质询ICE领导层关于缅因州和休斯敦案件相关录像披露时间表的问题。

segments.src: Whether that scrutiny leads to changes in the agency's release policy remains unclear.
segments.tr: 这种审查是否会导致该机构发布政策的改变仍不清楚。

segments.src: For now, ICE maintains that the camera rollout itself represents progress, regardless of the ongoing debate over disclosure rules.
segments.tr: 就目前而言，ICE坚持认为摄像机本身的推出代表了进展，无论关于披露规则的持续辩论如何。

segments.src: Agency officials have framed the expansion as one part of a broader modernization effort that also includes updated training and reporting requirements for field officers.
segments.tr: 该机构官员将这一扩展描述为更广泛现代化努力的一部分，该努力还包括外勤人员的更新培训和报告要求。

segments.src: Advocacy groups, meanwhile, say they will continue pressing for a binding timeline on footage release, arguing that cameras without a clear disclosure standard cannot fully deliver the accountability the program was designed to provide.
segments.tr: 与此同时，倡导组织表示他们将继续推动制定具有约束力的录像发布时间表。他们声称，没有明确披露标准的摄像机无法充分实现该计划旨在提供的问责。

segments.src: As the end-of-August deadline approaches, both supporters and critics of the policy agree on one point: how ICE handles footage from future incidents, not just whether cameras are worn, will determine whether the rollout meaningfully changes public trust in the agency's operations.
segments.tr: 随着八月底截止日期的临近，该政策的支持者和批评者在一点上达成一致：ICE如何处理未来事件的录像，而不仅仅是是否穿戴摄像机，将决定此次推出是否有意义地改变公众对该机构运营的信任。

segments.src: *This report reflects publicly available statements from ICE, congressional offices, and advocacy organizations as of publication.
segments.tr: *本报告反映了截至发布时从ICE、国会办公室和倡导组织获得的公开声明。

segments.src: Details of the Maine and Houston cases remain under review, and this article will be updated as verified information becomes available.*
segments.tr: 缅因州和休斯敦案件的细节仍在审查中。随着经过验证的信息出现，本文将被更新。*

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: U.S.

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says that by the end of August, every field officer conducting arrests and enforcement operations will be equipped with a body-worn camera.
segments.tr: इमिग्रेशन और कस्टम्स एनफोर्समेंट कहता है कि अगस्त के अंत तक, गिरफ्तारी और प्रवर्तन संचालन करने वाले हर फील्ड अधिकारी को एक बॉडी-वॉर्न कैमरे से लैस किया जाएगा।

segments.src: The agency has described the rollout as a milestone for transparency and accountability, arriving after years of pressure from lawmakers, civil-liberties groups, and immigrant-rights advocates who have long argued that ICE operations were undertaken with too little independent documentation.
segments.tr: एजेंसी ने इस रोलआउट को पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही के लिए एक मील का पत्थर के रूप में वर्णित किया है, जो कानून निर्माताओं, नागरिक-स्वतंत्रता समूहों और अप्रवासी-अधिकार वकीलों के वर्षों के दबाव के बाद आया है जिन्होंने लंबे समय से तर्क दिया है कि ICE संचालन बहुत कम स्वतंत्र दस्तावेज़ के साथ किए गए थे।

segments.src: According to agency statements, the initiative is meant to standardize how enforcement encounters are recorded, giving both officers and the public a consistent record of what happens during arrests, home visits, and transfers.
segments.tr: एजेंसी के बयानों के अनुसार, यह पहल प्रवर्तन मुठभेड़ों को कैसे रिकॉर्ड किया जाता है इसे मानकीकृत करने का इरादा है, अधिकारियों और जनता दोनों को गिरफ्तारी, घर की यात्रा और हस्तांतरण के दौरान क्या होता है इसका एक सुसंगत रिकॉर्ड देता है।

segments.src: Supporters of the plan, including some members of Congress who have pushed for expanded oversight of federal law enforcement, have welcomed the expansion as a step toward greater public trust.
segments.tr: योजना के समर्थक, कांग्रेस के कुछ सदस्यों सहित जिन्होंने संघीय कानून प्रवर्तन की विस्तारित निरीक्षण के लिए धकेल दिया है, ने विस्तार का स्वागत किया है जनता के विश्वास की ओर एक कदम के रूप में।

segments.src: ## The Provision Drawing Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## जांच आकर्षित करने वाला प्रावधान

segments.src: The rollout has not been without controversy.
segments.tr: रोलआउट विवाद के बिना नहीं रहा है।

segments.src: Under the policy as described by ICE, footage from incidents involving officer-involved shootings or deaths in custody is not automatically released to the public or to families.
segments.tr: ICE द्वारा वर्णित नीति के तहत, अधिकारी-संबंधित शूटिंग या हिरासत में मृत्यु से संबंधित घटनाओं से फुटेज को जनता या परिवारों को स्वचालित रूप से जारी नहीं किया जाता है।

segments.src: Instead, agency leadership retains discretion over when — or whether — such footage is disclosed, a provision that can allow recordings to be withheld indefinitely while internal reviews are underway.
segments.tr: इसके बजाय, एजेंसी नेतृत्व अपने विवेक में रखता है कि कब — या नहीं — ऐसे फुटेज का खुलासा किया जाता है, एक प्रावधान जो रिकॉर्डिंग को अनिश्चित काल के लिए रोके जाने की अनुमति दे सकता है जबकि आंतरिक समीक्षा चल रही है।

segments.src: That discretion has become the focal point of debate following two fatal encounters this summer, one in Maine and one in Houston, involving ICE personnel.
segments.tr: यह विवेक इस गर्मी में दो घातक मुठभेड़ों के बाद बहस के केंद्रबिंदु बन गया है, एक मेन में और एक ह्यूस्टन में, ICE कर्मियों को शामिल करते हुए।

segments.src: Details of both cases remain limited, and ICE has said that internal reviews are ongoing in accordance with standard procedure.
segments.tr: दोनों मामलों के विवरण सीमित रहते हैं, और ICE ने कहा है कि आंतरिक समीक्षा मानक प्रक्रिया के अनुसार चल रही है।

segments.src: Family members and local advocacy organizations connected to the cases have called for the release of any existing body-camera footage, saying that timely disclosure is essential for public confidence in how such incidents are investigated.
segments.tr: परिवार के सदस्यों और स्थानीय वकालत संगठनों से जुड़े मामलों ने किसी भी मौजूदा बॉडी-कैमरा फुटेज की रिहाई के लिए कहा है, कह रहे हैं कि समय पर प्रकटीकरण जनता के विश्वास के लिए आवश्यक है कि ऐसी घटनाओं की जांच कैसे की जाती है।

segments.src: Civil-liberties organizations, including groups that track use-of-force policies across federal agencies, argue that a body-camera program loses much of its accountability value if the agency being recorded also controls the release of the recordings.
segments.tr: नागरिक-स्वतंत्रता संगठन, संघीय एजेंसियों में बल के उपयोग की नीतियों को ट्रैक करने वाले समूहों सहित, तर्क देते हैं कि एक बॉडी-कैमरा कार्यक्रम अपने जवाबदेही मूल्य का बहुत कुछ खो देता है यदि रिकॉर्ड किया जा रहा एजेंसी भी रिकॉर्डिंग की रिहाई को नियंत्रित करता है।

segments.src: "A camera that only the agency can choose to show us isn't oversight, it's a promise," one policy analyst focused on law-enforcement transparency told reporters, describing a concern echoed by several advocacy groups following the announcement.
segments.tr: "एक कैमरा जो केवल एजेंसी हमें दिखाने के लिए चुन सकती है वह निरीक्षण नहीं है, यह एक वादा है," कानून-प्रवर्तन पारदर्शिता पर केंद्रित एक नीति विश्लेषक ने पत्रकारों को बताया, घोषणा के बाद कई वकालत समूहों द्वारा प्रतिध्वनित एक चिंता का वर्णन करते हुए।

segments.src: ## How ICE's Approach Compares
segments.tr: ## ICE का दृष्टिकोण कैसे तुलना करता है

segments.src: Body-camera policies vary widely across federal, state, and local law enforcement.
segments.tr: बॉडी-कैमरा नीतियां संघीय, राज्य और स्थानीय कानून प्रवर्तन में व्यापक रूप से भिन्न होती हैं।

segments.src: Many police departments release footage of fatal encounters within a set number of days, sometimes under legal mandates passed after high-profile incidents involving other agencies.
segments.tr: कई पुलिस विभाग एक निर्धारित संख्या के दिनों के भीतर घातल मुठभेड़ों का फुटेज जारी करते हैं, कभी-कभी अन्य एजेंसियों को शामिल करने वाली उच्च-प्रोफ़ाइल घटनाओं के बाद पारित कानूनी जनादेश के तहत।

segments.src: Federal agencies, including ICE, generally operate under different rules, often citing ongoing investigations, personnel privacy, and pending litigation as reasons for withholding footage for extended periods.
segments.tr: संघीय एजेंसियां, ICE सहित, आमतौर पर विभिन्न नियमों के तहत काम करती हैं, अक्सर चल रही जांच, कर्मचारी गोपनीयता और लंबित मुकदमेबाजी को विस्तारित अवधि के लिए फुटेज को रोकने के कारणों के रूप में उद्धृत करती हैं।

segments.src: Department of Homeland Security officials, of which ICE is a component, have previously said that footage from significant incidents is reviewed internally before any public release to ensure accuracy and to avoid compromising active investigations.
segments.tr: होमलैंड सिक्योरिटी विभाग के अधिकारी, जिनमें ICE एक घटक है, पहले कहा है कि महत्वपूर्ण घटनाओं से फुटेज को किसी भी सार्वजनिक रिहाई से पहले आंतरिक रूप से समीक्षा की जाती है सटीकता सुनिश्चित करने और सक्रिय जांच को समझौता करने से बचने के लिए।

segments.src: Officials have also noted that footage may ultimately be shared with oversight bodies, courts, or families through formal channels even when it is not made public immediately.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों ने यह भी नोट किया है कि फुटेज को अंततः निरीक्षण निकायों, अदालतों या परिवारों के साथ औपचारिक चैनलों के माध्यम से साझा किया जा सकता है भले ही इसे तुरंत सार्वजनिक नहीं किया जाता है।

segments.src: ## What Advocates and Officials Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## वकील और अधिकारी अगले क्या देख रहे हैं

segments.src: Lawmakers on relevant congressional committees have signaled interest in questioning ICE leadership about the disclosure timeline for footage tied to the Maine and Houston cases, according to statements from congressional offices following the incidents.
segments.tr: प्रासंगिक कांग्रेसी समितियों पर कानून निर्माताओं ने मेन और ह्यूस्टन मामलों से जुड़े फुटेज के प्रकटीकरण समय सारणी के बारे में ICE नेतृत्व से सवाल करने में रुचि का संकेत दिया है, घटनाओं के बाद कांग्रेसी कार्यालयों के बयानों के अनुसार।

segments.src: Whether that scrutiny leads to changes in the agency's release policy remains unclear.
segments.tr: क्या यह जांच एजेंसी की रिहाई नीति में परिवर्तन की ओर ले जाती है यह अस्पष्ट रहता है।

segments.src: For now, ICE maintains that the camera rollout itself represents progress, regardless of the ongoing debate over disclosure rules.
segments.tr: अभी के लिए, ICE दावा करता है कि कैमरा रोलआउट स्वयं प्रगति का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, प्रकटीकरण नियमों पर चल रही बहस की परवाह किए बिना।

segments.src: Agency officials have framed the expansion as one part of a broader modernization effort that also includes updated training and reporting requirements for field officers.
segments.tr: एजेंसी अधिकारियों ने विस्तार को एक व्यापक आधुनिकीकरण प्रयास के एक हिस्से के रूप में तैयार किया है जिसमें फील्ड अधिकारियों के लिए अद्यतन प्रशिक्षण और रिपोर्टिंग आवश्यकताएं भी शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Advocacy groups, meanwhile, say they will continue pressing for a binding timeline on footage release, arguing that cameras without a clear disclosure standard cannot fully deliver the accountability the program was designed to provide.
segments.tr: वकालत समूह, इस बीच, कहते हैं कि वे फुटेज रिहाई पर एक बाध्यकारी समय सारणी के लिए दबाव जारी रखेंगे, तर्क देते हुए कि एक स्पष्ट प्रकटीकरण मानक के बिना कैमरे पूरी तरह से जवाबदेही प्रदान नहीं कर सकते जिसे प्रोग्राम प्रदान करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया था।

segments.src: As the end-of-August deadline approaches, both supporters and critics of the policy agree on one point: how ICE handles footage from future incidents, not just whether cameras are worn, will determine whether the rollout meaningfully changes public trust in the agency's operations.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे अगस्त के अंत की समय सीमा निकट आती है, नीति के समर्थक और आलोचक दोनों एक बिंदु पर सहमत हैं: ICE भविष्य की घटनाओं से फुटेज को कैसे संभालता है, केवल यह नहीं कि कैमरे पहने जाते हैं, यह निर्धारित करेगा कि रोलआउट सार्वजनिक विश्वास को अर्थपूर्ण रूप से बदलता है या नहीं एजेंसी के संचालन में।

segments.src: *This report reflects publicly available statements from ICE, congressional offices, and advocacy organizations as of publication.
segments.tr: *यह रिपोर्ट प्रकाशन के समय ICE, कांग्रेसी कार्यालयों और वकालत संगठनों के सार्वजनिक रूप से उपलब्ध बयानों को दर्शाती है।

segments.src: Details of the Maine and Houston cases remain under review, and this article will be updated as verified information becomes available.*
segments.tr: मेन और ह्यूस्टन मामलों का विवरण समीक्षाधीन रहता है, और यह लेख अद्यतन किया जाएगा क्योंकि सत्यापित जानकारी उपलब्ध होती है।*

es.title: Una cámara en cada agente, un cerrojo en cada grabación: Dentro del despliegue de cámaras corporales de ICE a finales de agosto

segments.src: ## A Long-Awaited Policy Reaches Its Deadline
segments.tr: ## Una política esperada llega a su plazo final

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: U.S.

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says that by the end of August, every field officer conducting arrests and enforcement operations will be equipped with a body-worn camera.
segments.tr: Immigration and Customs Enforcement dice que para finales de agosto, cada agente de campo que realice arrestos y operaciones de cumplimiento estará equipado con una cámara corporal.

segments.src: The agency has described the rollout as a milestone for transparency and accountability, arriving after years of pressure from lawmakers, civil-liberties groups, and immigrant-rights advocates who have long argued that ICE operations were undertaken with too little independent documentation.
segments.tr: La agencia ha descrito el despliegue como un hito de transparencia y rendición de cuentas, que llega después de años de presión de legisladores, grupos defensores de libertades civiles, y defensores de derechos de inmigrantes que durante mucho tiempo han argumentado que las operaciones de ICE se realizaban con muy poca documentación independiente.

segments.src: According to agency statements, the initiative is meant to standardize how enforcement encounters are recorded, giving both officers and the public a consistent record of what happens during arrests, home visits, and transfers.
segments.tr: Según declaraciones de la agencia, la iniciativa busca estandarizar cómo se registran los encuentros de cumplimiento, proporcionando tanto a los agentes como al público un registro consistente de lo que sucede durante arrestos, visitas domiciliarias y traslados.

segments.src: Supporters of the plan, including some members of Congress who have pushed for expanded oversight of federal law enforcement, have welcomed the expansion as a step toward greater public trust.
segments.tr: Los partidarios del plan, incluidos algunos miembros del Congreso que han presionado por una supervisión ampliada de la aplicación de la ley federal, han acogido la expansión como un paso hacia una mayor confianza pública.

segments.src: ## The Provision Drawing Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## La disposición que atrae escrutinio

segments.src: The rollout has not been without controversy.
segments.tr: El despliegue no ha estado libre de controversia.

segments.src: Under the policy as described by ICE, footage from incidents involving officer-involved shootings or deaths in custody is not automatically released to the public or to families.
segments.tr: Según la política descrita por ICE, las grabaciones de incidentes que involucran disparos de agentes o muertes bajo custodia no se liberan automáticamente al público o a las familias.

segments.src: Instead, agency leadership retains discretion over when — or whether — such footage is disclosed, a provision that can allow recordings to be withheld indefinitely while internal reviews are underway.
segments.tr: En su lugar, el liderazgo de la agencia retiene discreción sobre cuándo—o si—se divulga tal grabación, una disposición que puede permitir que las grabaciones se retengan indefinidamente mientras las revisiones internas están en curso.

segments.src: That discretion has become the focal point of debate following two fatal encounters this summer, one in Maine and one in Houston, involving ICE personnel.
segments.tr: Esa discreción se ha convertido en el punto central del debate tras dos encuentros fatales este verano, uno en Maine y otro en Houston, en los que participó personal de ICE.

segments.src: Details of both cases remain limited, and ICE has said that internal reviews are ongoing in accordance with standard procedure.
segments.tr: Los detalles de ambos casos siguen siendo limitados, e ICE ha dicho que las revisiones internas están en curso de conformidad con el procedimiento estándar.

segments.src: Family members and local advocacy organizations connected to the cases have called for the release of any existing body-camera footage, saying that timely disclosure is essential for public confidence in how such incidents are investigated.
segments.tr: Miembros de la familia y organizaciones locales de defensa relacionadas con los casos han pedido la liberación de cualquier grabación de cámara corporal existente, diciendo que la divulgación oportuna es esencial para la confianza pública en cómo se investigan tales incidentes.

segments.src: Civil-liberties organizations, including groups that track use-of-force policies across federal agencies, argue that a body-camera program loses much of its accountability value if the agency being recorded also controls the release of the recordings.
segments.tr: Las organizaciones defensoras de libertades civiles, incluidos grupos que rastrean políticas de uso de la fuerza en todas las agencias federales, argumentan que un programa de cámara corporal pierde mucho de su valor de rendición de cuentas si la agencia siendo grabada también controla la liberación de las grabaciones.

segments.src: "A camera that only the agency can choose to show us isn't oversight, it's a promise," one policy analyst focused on law-enforcement transparency told reporters, describing a concern echoed by several advocacy groups following the announcement.
segments.tr: "Una cámara que solo la agencia puede elegir mostrarnos no es supervisión, es una promesa", dijo un analista de políticas enfocado en la transparencia de la aplicación de la ley a los reporteros, describiendo una preocupación que varios grupos de defensa repitieron después del anuncio.

segments.src: ## How ICE's Approach Compares
segments.tr: ## Cómo se compara el enfoque de ICE

segments.src: Body-camera policies vary widely across federal, state, and local law enforcement.
segments.tr: Las políticas de cámaras corporales varían ampliamente entre la aplicación de la ley federal, estatal y local.

segments.src: Many police departments release footage of fatal encounters within a set number of days, sometimes under legal mandates passed after high-profile incidents involving other agencies.
segments.tr: Muchos departamentos de policía liberan grabaciones de encuentros fatales dentro de un número establecido de días, a veces bajo mandatos legales aprobados después de incidentes de alto perfil que involucran otras agencias.

segments.src: Federal agencies, including ICE, generally operate under different rules, often citing ongoing investigations, personnel privacy, and pending litigation as reasons for withholding footage for extended periods.
segments.tr: Las agencias federales, incluida ICE, generalmente operan bajo reglas diferentes, a menudo citando investigaciones en curso, privacidad del personal, y litigios pendientes como razones para retener grabaciones por períodos extendidos.

segments.src: Department of Homeland Security officials, of which ICE is a component, have previously said that footage from significant incidents is reviewed internally before any public release to ensure accuracy and to avoid compromising active investigations.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional, del cual ICE es un componente, han dicho anteriormente que las grabaciones de incidentes significativos se revisan internamente antes de cualquier liberación pública para garantizar la precisión y evitar comprometer investigaciones activas.

segments.src: Officials have also noted that footage may ultimately be shared with oversight bodies, courts, or families through formal channels even when it is not made public immediately.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios también han señalado que las grabaciones pueden finalmente compartirse con órganos de supervisión, tribunales, o familias a través de canales formales incluso cuando no se hacen públicas inmediatamente.

segments.src: ## What Advocates and Officials Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## Qué están observando a continuación los defensores y funcionarios

segments.src: Lawmakers on relevant congressional committees have signaled interest in questioning ICE leadership about the disclosure timeline for footage tied to the Maine and Houston cases, according to statements from congressional offices following the incidents.
segments.tr: Los legisladores de los comités del Congreso pertinentes han señalado interés en cuestionar al liderazgo de ICE sobre la línea de tiempo de divulgación para grabaciones vinculadas a los casos de Maine y Houston, según declaraciones de las oficinas del Congreso después de los incidentes.

segments.src: Whether that scrutiny leads to changes in the agency's release policy remains unclear.
segments.tr: Si ese escrutinio lleva a cambios en la política de liberación de la agencia sigue siendo poco claro.

segments.src: For now, ICE maintains that the camera rollout itself represents progress, regardless of the ongoing debate over disclosure rules.
segments.tr: Por ahora, ICE sostiene que el despliegue de cámaras en sí representa progreso, independientemente del debate en curso sobre las reglas de divulgación.

segments.src: Agency officials have framed the expansion as one part of a broader modernization effort that also includes updated training and reporting requirements for field officers.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de la agencia han presentado la expansión como una parte de un esfuerzo de modernización más amplio que también incluye requisitos actualizados de capacitación e informes para agentes de campo.

segments.src: Advocacy groups, meanwhile, say they will continue pressing for a binding timeline on footage release, arguing that cameras without a clear disclosure standard cannot fully deliver the accountability the program was designed to provide.
segments.tr: Los grupos de defensa, mientras tanto, dicen que continuarán presionando por un cronograma vinculante en la liberación de grabaciones, argumentando que las cámaras sin un estándar claro de divulgación no pueden entregar completamente la rendición de cuentas que el programa fue diseñado para proporcionar.

segments.src: As the end-of-August deadline approaches, both supporters and critics of the policy agree on one point: how ICE handles footage from future incidents, not just whether cameras are worn, will determine whether the rollout meaningfully changes public trust in the agency's operations.
segments.tr: A medida que se acerca la fecha límite de finales de agosto, tanto los partidarios como los críticos de la política están de acuerdo en un punto: cómo ICE maneja las grabaciones de incidentes futuros, no solo si se usan cámaras, determinará si el despliegue cambia significativamente la confianza pública en las operaciones de la agencia.

ar.title: كاميرا على كل ضابط، قفل على كل شريط: داخل طرح كاميرات ICE لنهاية أغسطس

segments.src: ## A Long-Awaited Policy Reaches Its Deadline
segments.tr: ## سياسة طال انتظارها تصل إلى موعدها النهائي

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: U.S.

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says that by the end of August, every field officer conducting arrests and enforcement operations will be equipped with a body-worn camera.
segments.tr: تقول إدارة الهجرة والجمارك الأمريكية أنه بحلول نهاية أغسطس، سيكون كل ضابط ميداني يجري عمليات اعتقال وإنفاذ مزودًا بكاميرا ترتديها الجسم.

segments.src: The agency has described the rollout as a milestone for transparency and accountability, arriving after years of pressure from lawmakers, civil-liberties groups, and immigrant-rights advocates who have long argued that ICE operations were undertaken with too little independent documentation.
segments.tr: وصفت الوكالة طرح الخدمة بأنه علامة فارقة للشفافية والمساءلة، جاءت بعد سنوات من الضغط من الساسة والمنظمات المدافعة عن الحريات المدنية ومناصري حقوق المهاجرين الذين طالما جادلوا بأن عمليات ICE تمت بقدر قليل جداً من التوثيق المستقل.

segments.src: According to agency statements, the initiative is meant to standardize how enforcement encounters are recorded, giving both officers and the public a consistent record of what happens during arrests, home visits, and transfers.
segments.tr: وفقاً لبيانات الوكالة، تهدف المبادرة إلى توحيد طريقة تسجيل التقاءات الإنفاذ، مما يعطي الضباط والجمهور سجلاً متسقاً بما يحدث أثناء الاعتقالات والزيارات المنزلية والنقل.

segments.src: Supporters of the plan, including some members of Congress who have pushed for expanded oversight of federal law enforcement, have welcomed the expansion as a step toward greater public trust.
segments.tr: استقبل مؤيدو الخطة، بما في ذلك بعض أعضاء الكونجرس الذين دفعوا من أجل توسيع الرقابة على إنفاذ القانون الفيدرالي، التوسع باعتباره خطوة نحو ثقة عامة أكبر.

segments.src: ## The Provision Drawing Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## الحكم الذي يلفت الانتباه

segments.src: The rollout has not been without controversy.
segments.tr: لم يخل الطرح من الجدل.

segments.src: Under the policy as described by ICE, footage from incidents involving officer-involved shootings or deaths in custody is not automatically released to the public or to families.
segments.tr: بموجب السياسة كما وصفتها ICE، لا يتم الإفراج تلقائياً عن المقاطع المصورة من الحوادث التي تنطوي على إطلاق نار من ضابط أو وفيات أثناء الاحتجاز إلى الجمهور أو للعائلات.

segments.src: Instead, agency leadership retains discretion over when — or whether — such footage is disclosed, a provision that can allow recordings to be withheld indefinitely while internal reviews are underway.
segments.tr: بدلاً من ذلك، تحتفظ قيادة الوكالة بسلطة تقديرية حول متى - أو ما إذا - يتم الكشف عن مثل هذه المقاطع المصورة، وهو حكم يمكن أن يسمح بعدم الإفراج عن التسجيلات إلى أجل غير مسمى بينما تجري المراجعات الداخلية.

segments.src: That discretion has become the focal point of debate following two fatal encounters this summer, one in Maine and one in Houston, involving ICE personnel.
segments.tr: أصبحت هذه السلطة التقديرية نقطة التركيز في النقاش بعد التقائين مميتين هذا الصيف، أحدهما في Maine والآخر في Houston، يتعلقان بموظفي ICE.

segments.src: Details of both cases remain limited, and ICE has said that internal reviews are ongoing in accordance with standard procedure.
segments.tr: تبقى تفاصيل كلا الحالتين محدودة، وقالت ICE أن المراجعات الداخلية جارية وفقاً للإجراء المعياري.

segments.src: Family members and local advocacy organizations connected to the cases have called for the release of any existing body-camera footage, saying that timely disclosure is essential for public confidence in how such incidents are investigated.
segments.tr: دعا أفراد الأسرة والمنظمات المحلية المدافعة المرتبطة بالحالات إلى الإفراج عن أي مقاطع مصورة موجودة للكاميرا الموجودة على الجسم، قائلين إن الكشف في الوقت المناسب ضروري لثقة الجمهور في كيفية التحقيق في مثل هذه الحوادث.

segments.src: Civil-liberties organizations, including groups that track use-of-force policies across federal agencies, argue that a body-camera program loses much of its accountability value if the agency being recorded also controls the release of the recordings.
segments.tr: تجادل منظمات الحريات المدنية، بما في ذلك المجموعات التي تراقب سياسات استخدام القوة عبر الوكالات الفيدرالية، بأن برنامج الكاميرا على الجسم يفقد الكثير من قيمته في المساءلة إذا كانت الوكالة التي يتم تسجيلها تتحكم أيضاً في الإفراج عن التسجيلات.

segments.src: "A camera that only the agency can choose to show us isn't oversight, it's a promise," one policy analyst focused on law-enforcement transparency told reporters, describing a concern echoed by several advocacy groups following the announcement.
segments.tr: "كاميرا لا يمكن إلا للوكالة أن تختار إظهارها لنا ليست رقابة، بل هي وعد،" قال محلل سياسات متخصص في الشفافية في إنفاذ القانون للصحفيين، واصفاً بذلك قلقاً رددته عدة مجموعات مدافعة بعد الإعلان.

segments.src: ## How ICE's Approach Compares
segments.tr: ## كيف يقارن نهج ICE

segments.src: Body-camera policies vary widely across federal, state, and local law enforcement.
segments.tr: تختلف سياسات الكاميرا على الجسم على نطاق واسع عبر إنفاذ القانون الفيدرالي والحكومي والمحلي.

segments.src: Many police departments release footage of fatal encounters within a set number of days, sometimes under legal mandates passed after high-profile incidents involving other agencies.
segments.tr: تصدر العديد من الإدارات البوليسية مقاطع مصورة للالتقاءات المميتة في غضون عدد محدد من الأيام، أحياناً بموجب الولايات القانونية التي تم تمريرها بعد حوادث بارزة تنطوي على وكالات أخرى.

segments.src: Federal agencies, including ICE, generally operate under different rules, often citing ongoing investigations, personnel privacy, and pending litigation as reasons for withholding footage for extended periods.
segments.tr: تعمل الوكالات الفيدرالية، بما في ذلك ICE، بشكل عام تحت قواعد مختلفة، غالباً ما تستشهد بالتحقيقات الجارية وخصوصية الموظفين والدعاوى القانونية المعلقة كأسباب لعدم الإفراج عن المقاطع المصورة لفترات طويلة.

segments.src: Department of Homeland Security officials, of which ICE is a component, have previously said that footage from significant incidents is reviewed internally before any public release to ensure accuracy and to avoid compromising active investigations.
segments.tr: قال مسؤولو وزارة الأمن الوطني، التي تعتبر ICE مكوناً فيها، مسبقاً بأن المقاطع المصورة من الحوادث الكبيرة يتم مراجعتها داخلياً قبل أي إفراج عام لضمان الدقة وتجنب المساس بالتحقيقات النشطة.

segments.src: Officials have also noted that footage may ultimately be shared with oversight bodies, courts, or families through formal channels even when it is not made public immediately.
segments.tr: لاحظ المسؤولون أيضاً أن المقاطع المصورة قد يتم مشاركتها في النهاية مع هيئات الرقابة أو المحاكم أو العائلات من خلال القنوات الرسمية حتى عندما لا يتم نشرها على الفور.

segments.src: ## What Advocates and Officials Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يراقبه المدافعون والمسؤولون بعد ذلك

segments.src: Lawmakers on relevant congressional committees have signaled interest in questioning ICE leadership about the disclosure timeline for footage tied to the Maine and Houston cases, according to statements from congressional offices following the incidents.
segments.tr: أشار صناع القوانين في لجان الكونجرس ذات الصلة إلى اهتمامهم باستجواب قيادة ICE بشأن الجدول الزمني للكشف عن المقاطع المصورة المرتبطة بحالات Maine و Houston، وفقاً لبيانات من مكاتب الكونجرس بعد الحوادث.

segments.src: Whether that scrutiny leads to changes in the agency's release policy remains unclear.
segments.tr: ما إذا كان هذا التدقيق يؤدي إلى تغييرات في سياسة الإفراج للوكالة يبقى غير واضح.

segments.src: For now, ICE maintains that the camera rollout itself represents progress, regardless of the ongoing debate over disclosure rules.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، تؤكد ICE أن طرح الكاميرا بحد ذاته يمثل تقدماً، بغض النظر عن النقاش الجاري حول قواعد الكشف.

segments.src: Agency officials have framed the expansion as one part of a broader modernization effort that also includes updated training and reporting requirements for field officers.
segments.tr: وقد أطر مسؤولو الوكالة التوسع كجزء واحد من جهد حداثة أوسع يشمل أيضاً متطلبات تدريب وإبلاغ محدثة لضباط الميدان.

segments.src: Advocacy groups, meanwhile, say they will continue pressing for a binding timeline on footage release, arguing that cameras without a clear disclosure standard cannot fully deliver the accountability the program was designed to provide.
segments.tr: تقول مجموعات الدعوة، في الوقت نفسه، إنها ستستمر في الضغط من أجل جدول زمني ملزم لإفراج المقاطع المصورة، محتجة بأن الكاميرات بدون معيار كشف واضح لا يمكن أن توفر بالكامل المساءلة التي صُممت البرنامج لتقديمها.

segments.src: As the end-of-August deadline approaches, both supporters and critics of the policy agree on one point: how ICE handles footage from future incidents, not just whether cameras are worn, will determine whether the rollout meaningfully changes public trust in the agency's operations.
segments.tr: مع اقتراب الموعد النهائي لنهاية أغسطس، يتفق كل من مؤيدي السياسة وانتقاديها على نقطة واحدة: كيفية تعامل ICE مع المقاطع المصورة من الحوادث المستقبلية، وليس فقط ما إذا كانت الكاميرات مرتدية، سيحدد ما إذا كان الطرح يغير بشكل هادف ثقة الجمهور في عمليات الوكالة.

segments.src: *This report reflects publicly available statements from ICE, congressional offices, and advocacy organizations as of publication.
segments.tr: *يعكس هذا التقرير البيانات المتاحة للجمهور من ICE ومكاتب الكونجرس والمنظمات المدافعة حتى تاريخ النشر.

segments.src: Details of the Maine and Houston cases remain under review, and this article will be updated as verified information becomes available.*
segments.tr: تبقى تفاصيل حالات Maine و Houston قيد المراجعة، وسيتم تحديث هذه المقالة عند توفر معلومات موثوقة.*

fr.title: Une Caméra pour Chaque Agent, un Verrou sur Chaque Enregistrement : Déploiement des Caméras Portées par le Service de l'Immigration et des Douanes en Fin Août

segments.src: ## A Long-Awaited Policy Reaches Its Deadline
segments.tr: ## Une Politique Attendue Depuis Longtemps Atteint sa Date Limite

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: U.S.

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says that by the end of August, every field officer conducting arrests and enforcement operations will be equipped with a body-worn camera.
segments.tr: Le Service de l'immigration et des douanes déclare que d'ici la fin août, tous les agents de terrain effectuant des arrestations et des opérations d'application de la loi seront équipés d'une caméra portée.

segments.src: The agency has described the rollout as a milestone for transparency and accountability, arriving after years of pressure from lawmakers, civil-liberties groups, and immigrant-rights advocates who have long argued that ICE operations were undertaken with too little independent documentation.
segments.tr: L'agence a décrit le déploiement comme une étape importante pour la transparence et la responsabilité, intervenant après des années de pression de la part des législateurs, des groupes de défense des libertés civiles et des défenseurs des droits des immigrants qui ont longtemps soutenu que les opérations du Service de l'immigration et des douanes étaient menées avec trop peu de documentation indépendante.

segments.src: According to agency statements, the initiative is meant to standardize how enforcement encounters are recorded, giving both officers and the public a consistent record of what happens during arrests, home visits, and transfers.
segments.tr: Selon les déclarations de l'agence, l'initiative vise à normaliser la façon dont les rencontres d'application de la loi sont enregistrées, donnant aux agents et au public un dossier cohérent de ce qui se passe lors des arrestations, des visites à domicile et des transferts.

segments.src: Supporters of the plan, including some members of Congress who have pushed for expanded oversight of federal law enforcement, have welcomed the expansion as a step toward greater public trust.
segments.tr: Les partisans du plan, y compris certains membres du Congrès qui ont plaidé pour une surveillance accrue de l'application de la loi fédérale, ont accueilli favorablement l'expansion comme une étape vers une plus grande confiance du public.

segments.src: ## The Provision Drawing Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## La Disposition Attirant l'Examen

segments.src: The rollout has not been without controversy.
segments.tr: Le déploiement n'a pas été sans controverse.

segments.src: Under the policy as described by ICE, footage from incidents involving officer-involved shootings or deaths in custody is not automatically released to the public or to families.
segments.tr: Selon la politique décrite par le Service de l'immigration et des douanes, les images d'incidents impliquant des tirs par un agent ou des décès en détention ne sont pas automatiquement divulguées au public ou aux familles.

segments.src: Instead, agency leadership retains discretion over when — or whether — such footage is disclosed, a provision that can allow recordings to be withheld indefinitely while internal reviews are underway.
segments.tr: Au lieu de cela, la direction de l'agence conserve le pouvoir discrétionnaire de décider quand — ou si — ces images sont divulguées, une disposition qui peut permettre à des enregistrements d'être retenus indéfiniment pendant que des examens internes sont en cours.

segments.src: That discretion has become the focal point of debate following two fatal encounters this summer, one in Maine and one in Houston, involving ICE personnel.
segments.tr: Ce pouvoir discrétionnaire est devenu le point central du débat suite à deux rencontres mortelles cet été, une dans le Maine et une à Houston, impliquant du personnel du Service de l'immigration et des douanes.

segments.src: Details of both cases remain limited, and ICE has said that internal reviews are ongoing in accordance with standard procedure.
segments.tr: Les détails des deux cas restent limités, et le Service de l'immigration et des douanes a déclaré que des examens internes sont en cours conformément à la procédure standard.

segments.src: Family members and local advocacy organizations connected to the cases have called for the release of any existing body-camera footage, saying that timely disclosure is essential for public confidence in how such incidents are investigated.
segments.tr: Les membres de la famille et les organisations de défense locales liées aux cas ont demandé la divulgation de toutes les images de caméra portée existantes, affirmant que la divulgation en temps opportun est essentielle pour la confiance du public dans la façon dont ces incidents sont enquêtés.

segments.src: Civil-liberties organizations, including groups that track use-of-force policies across federal agencies, argue that a body-camera program loses much of its accountability value if the agency being recorded also controls the release of the recordings.
segments.tr: Les organisations de défense des libertés civiles, y compris les groupes qui suivent les politiques d'usage de la force dans les agences fédérales, soutiennent qu'un programme de caméra portée perd une grande partie de sa valeur de responsabilité si l'agence enregistrée contrôle également la divulgation des enregistrements.

segments.src: "A camera that only the agency can choose to show us isn't oversight, it's a promise," one policy analyst focused on law-enforcement transparency told reporters, describing a concern echoed by several advocacy groups following the announcement.
segments.tr: « Une caméra que seule l'agence peut choisir de nous montrer n'est pas de la surveillance, c'est une promesse », a déclaré à des journalistes un analyste des politiques spécialisé dans la transparence de l'application de la loi, décrivant une préoccupation partagée par plusieurs groupes de défense suite à l'annonce.

segments.src: ## How ICE's Approach Compares
segments.tr: ## Comment l'Approche du Service de l'Immigration et des Douanes se Compare

segments.src: Body-camera policies vary widely across federal, state, and local law enforcement.
segments.tr: Les politiques relatives aux caméras portées varient considérablement entre les organismes fédéraux, d'État et locaux d'application de la loi.

segments.src: Many police departments release footage of fatal encounters within a set number of days, sometimes under legal mandates passed after high-profile incidents involving other agencies.
segments.tr: De nombreux services de police divulguent des images de rencontres mortelles dans un délai défini, parfois en vertu de mandats légaux adoptés après des incidents très médiatisés impliquant d'autres agences.

segments.src: Federal agencies, including ICE, generally operate under different rules, often citing ongoing investigations, personnel privacy, and pending litigation as reasons for withholding footage for extended periods.
segments.tr: Les agences fédérales, y compris le Service de l'immigration et des douanes, opèrent généralement selon des règles différentes, citant souvent les enquêtes en cours, la confidentialité du personnel et les litiges en attente comme raisons pour retenir les images pendant des périodes prolongées.

segments.src: Department of Homeland Security officials, of which ICE is a component, have previously said that footage from significant incidents is reviewed internally before any public release to ensure accuracy and to avoid compromising active investigations.
segments.tr: Les responsables du Département de la Sécurité intérieure, dont le Service de l'immigration et des douanes est une composante, ont précédemment déclaré que les images d'incidents importants sont examinées en interne avant toute divulgation publique pour assurer l'exactitude et éviter de compromettre les enquêtes actives.

segments.src: Officials have also noted that footage may ultimately be shared with oversight bodies, courts, or families through formal channels even when it is not made public immediately.
segments.tr: Les responsables ont également noté que les images peuvent finalement être partagées avec les organes de surveillance, les tribunaux ou les familles par des canaux formels même si elles ne sont pas rendues publiques immédiatement.

segments.src: ## What Advocates and Officials Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## Ce que les Défenseurs et les Responsables Observent Ensuite

segments.src: Lawmakers on relevant congressional committees have signaled interest in questioning ICE leadership about the disclosure timeline for footage tied to the Maine and Houston cases, according to statements from congressional offices following the incidents.
segments.tr: Les législateurs des commissions parlementaires compétentes ont signalé un intérêt à interroger la direction du Service de l'immigration et des douanes sur le calendrier de divulgation des images liées aux cas du Maine et de Houston, selon les déclarations des bureaux parlementaires suite aux incidents.

segments.src: Whether that scrutiny leads to changes in the agency's release policy remains unclear.
segments.tr: Il reste à savoir si cet examen mène à des changements dans la politique de divulgation de l'agence.

segments.src: For now, ICE maintains that the camera rollout itself represents progress, regardless of the ongoing debate over disclosure rules.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, le Service de l'immigration et des douanes maintient que le déploiement des caméras lui-même représente un progrès, indépendamment du débat en cours sur les règles de divulgation.

segments.src: Agency officials have framed the expansion as one part of a broader modernization effort that also includes updated training and reporting requirements for field officers.
segments.tr: Les responsables de l'agence ont présenté l'expansion comme une partie d'un effort de modernisation plus large qui comprend également des exigences de formation et de rapport mises à jour pour les agents de terrain.

segments.src: Advocacy groups, meanwhile, say they will continue pressing for a binding timeline on footage release, arguing that cameras without a clear disclosure standard cannot fully deliver the accountability the program was designed to provide.
segments.tr: Les groupes de défense, pendant ce temps, disent qu'ils continueront à demander un calendrier contraignant de divulgation des images, arguant que les caméras sans norme de divulgation claire ne peuvent pas pleinement fournir la responsabilité que le programme a été conçu pour fournir.

segments.src: As the end-of-August deadline approaches, both supporters and critics of the policy agree on one point: how ICE handles footage from future incidents, not just whether cameras are worn, will determine whether the rollout meaningfully changes public trust in the agency's operations.
segments.tr: À l'approche de la date limite de fin août, les partisans et les critiques de la politique conviennent d'un point : la façon dont le Service de l'immigration et des douanes traite les images d'incidents futurs, et pas seulement si les caméras sont portées, déterminera si le déploiement change de manière significative la confiance du public dans les opérations de l'agence.

segments.src: *This report reflects publicly available statements from ICE, congressional offices, and advocacy organizations as of publication.
segments.tr: *Ce rapport reflète les déclarations disponibles au public du Service de l'immigration et des douanes, des bureaux parlementaires et des organisations de défense à la date de publication.

segments.tr: De acordo com declarações da agência, a iniciativa visa padronizar como os encontros de fiscalização são registrados, fornecendo aos agentes e ao público um registro consistente do que acontece durante prisões, visitas domiciliares e transferências.

segments.src: Supporters of the plan, including some members of Congress who have pushed for expanded oversight of federal law enforcement, have welcomed the expansion as a step toward greater public trust.
segments.tr: Apoiadores do plano, incluindo alguns membros do Congresso que pressionaram por maior supervisão da aplicação da lei federal, receberam bem a expansão como um passo em direção a maior confiança pública.

segments.src: ## The Provision Drawing Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## A Disposição Atraindo Escrutínio

segments.src: The rollout has not been without controversy.
segments.tr: O lançamento não foi sem controvérsia.

segments.src: Under the policy as described by ICE, footage from incidents involving officer-involved shootings or deaths in custody is not automatically released to the public or to families.
segments.tr: De acordo com a política descrita pelo ICE, as gravações de incidentes envolvendo disparos por agentes ou mortes sob custódia não são automaticamente divulgadas ao público ou às famílias.

segments.src: Instead, agency leadership retains discretion over when — or whether — such footage is disclosed, a provision that can allow recordings to be withheld indefinitely while internal reviews are underway.
segments.tr: Em vez disso, a liderança da agência retém discrição sobre quando — ou se — tal gravação é divulgada, uma disposição que pode permitir que as gravações sejam retidas indefinidamente enquanto avaliações internas estão em andamento.

segments.src: That discretion has become the focal point of debate following two fatal encounters this summer, one in Maine and one in Houston, involving ICE personnel.
segments.tr: Essa discrição tornou-se o ponto focal do debate após dois encontros fatais neste verão, um no Maine e outro em Houston, envolvendo pessoal do ICE.

segments.src: Details of both cases remain limited, and ICE has said that internal reviews are ongoing in accordance with standard procedure.
segments.tr: Detalhes de ambos os casos permanecem limitados, e o ICE disse que avaliações internas estão em andamento de acordo com o procedimento padrão.

segments.src: Family members and local advocacy organizations connected to the cases have called for the release of any existing body-camera footage, saying that timely disclosure is essential for public confidence in how such incidents are investigated.
segments.tr: Membros das famílias e organizações de defesa locais conectadas aos casos pediram a liberação de qualquer gravação de câmera corporal existente, dizendo que a divulgação oportuna é essencial para a confiança pública em como tais incidentes são investigados.

segments.src: Civil-liberties organizations, including groups that track use-of-force policies across federal agencies, argue that a body-camera program loses much of its accountability value if the agency being recorded also controls the release of the recordings.
segments.tr: Organizações de direitos civis, incluindo grupos que rastreiam políticas de uso da força em agências federais, argumentam que um programa de câmera corporal perde muito de seu valor de responsabilidade se a agência sendo gravada também controlar a divulgação das gravações.

segments.src: "A camera that only the agency can choose to show us isn't oversight, it's a promise," one policy analyst focused on law-enforcement transparency told reporters, describing a concern echoed by several advocacy groups following the announcement.
segments.tr: "Uma câmera que apenas a agência pode escolher nos mostrar não é supervisão, é uma promessa," disse um analista de políticas focado em transparência na aplicação da lei aos repórteres, descrevendo uma preocupação ecoada por vários grupos de defesa após o anúncio.

segments.src: ## How ICE's Approach Compares
segments.tr: ## Como a Abordagem do ICE se Compara

segments.src: Body-camera policies vary widely across federal, state, and local law enforcement.
segments.tr: As políticas de câmera corporal variam muito entre aplicação da lei federal, estadual e local.

segments.src: Many police departments release footage of fatal encounters within a set number of days, sometimes under legal mandates passed after high-profile incidents involving other agencies.
segments.tr: Muitos departamentos de polícia divulgam gravações de encontros fatais dentro de um número definido de dias, às vezes sob mandatos legais aprovados após incidentes de alto perfil envolvendo outras agências.

segments.src: Federal agencies, including ICE, generally operate under different rules, often citing ongoing investigations, personnel privacy, and pending litigation as reasons for withholding footage for extended periods.
segments.tr: Agências federais, incluindo o ICE, geralmente operam sob regras diferentes, frequentemente citando investigações em andamento, privacidade do pessoal e litígios pendentes como razões para reter gravações por períodos prolongados.

segments.src: Department of Homeland Security officials, of which ICE is a component, have previously said that footage from significant incidents is reviewed internally before any public release to ensure accuracy and to avoid compromising active investigations.
segments.tr: Oficiais do Departamento de Segurança Interna, do qual o ICE é um componente, disseram anteriormente que as gravações de incidentes significativos são revisadas internamente antes de qualquer divulgação pública para garantir precisão e evitar comprometer investigações ativas.

segments.src: Officials have also noted that footage may ultimately be shared with oversight bodies, courts, or families through formal channels even when it is not made public immediately.
segments.tr: Oficiais também observaram que as gravações podem eventualmente ser compartilhadas com órgãos de supervisão, tribunais ou famílias através de canais formais, mesmo quando não são tornadas públicas imediatamente.

segments.src: ## What Advocates and Officials Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Defensores e Oficiais Estão Observando a Seguir

segments.src: Lawmakers on relevant congressional committees have signaled interest in questioning ICE leadership about the disclosure timeline for footage tied to the Maine and Houston cases, according to statements from congressional offices following the incidents.
segments.tr: Legisladores em comitês congressionais relevantes sinalizaram interesse em questionar a liderança do ICE sobre o cronograma de divulgação de gravações relacionadas aos casos do Maine e Houston, de acordo com declarações de escritórios congressionais após os incidentes.

segments.src: Whether that scrutiny leads to changes in the agency's release policy remains unclear.
segments.tr: Se esse escrutínio leva a mudanças na política de divulgação da agência permanece incerto.

segments.src: For now, ICE maintains that the camera rollout itself represents progress, regardless of the ongoing debate over disclosure rules.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, o ICE sustenta que o lançamento da câmera em si representa progresso, independentemente do debate contínuo sobre as regras de divulgação.

segments.src: Agency officials have framed the expansion as one part of a broader modernization effort that also includes updated training and reporting requirements for field officers.
segments.tr: Oficiais da agência enquadraram a expansão como parte de um esforço de modernização mais amplo que também inclui treinamento atualizado e requisitos de relatórios para agentes de campo.

segments.src: Advocacy groups, meanwhile, say they will continue pressing for a binding timeline on footage release, arguing that cameras without a clear disclosure standard cannot fully deliver the accountability the program was designed to provide.
segments.tr: Grupos de defesa, enquanto isso, dizem que continuarão pressionando por um cronograma vinculante para divulgação de gravações, argumentando que câmeras sem um padrão de divulgação claro não podem fornecer completamente a responsabilidade que o programa foi projetado para fornecer.

segments.src: As the end-of-August deadline approaches, both supporters and critics of the policy agree on one point: how ICE handles footage from future incidents, not just whether cameras are worn, will determine whether the rollout meaningfully changes public trust in the agency's operations.
segments.tr: À medida que o prazo do final de agosto se aproxima, apoiadores e críticos da política concordam em um ponto: como o ICE lida com as gravações de incidentes futuros, não apenas se as câmeras são usadas, determinará se o lançamento muda significativamente a confiança pública nas operações da agência.

segments.src: *This report reflects publicly available statements from ICE, congressional offices, and advocacy organizations as of publication.
segments.tr: *Este relatório reflete declarações disponíveis publicamente do ICE, escritórios congressionais e organizações de defesa a partir da publicação.

segments.src: Details of the Maine and Houston cases remain under review, and this article will be updated as verified information becomes available.*
segments.tr: Detalhes dos casos do Maine e Houston permanecem sob revisão, e este artigo será atualizado conforme informações verificadas se tornarem disponíveis.*

in.title: Kamera di Setiap Petugas, Kunci di Setiap Rekaman: Peluncuran Kamera Tubuh ICE Akhir Agustus

segments.src: ## A Long-Awaited Policy Reaches Its Deadline
segments.tr: ## Kebijakan yang Ditunggu-tunggu Mencapai Tenggat Waktu

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: U.S.

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says that by the end of August, every field officer conducting arrests and enforcement operations will be equipped with a body-worn camera.
segments.tr: Immigration and Customs Enforcement mengatakan bahwa pada akhir Agustus, setiap petugas lapangan yang melakukan penangkapan dan operasi penegakan akan dilengkapi dengan kamera yang dikenakan di tubuh.

segments.src: The agency has described the rollout as a milestone for transparency and accountability, arriving after years of pressure from lawmakers, civil-liberties groups, and immigrant-rights advocates who have long argued that ICE operations were undertaken with too little independent documentation.
segments.tr: Agensi telah menggambarkan peluncuran ini sebagai tonggak penting untuk transparansi dan akuntabilitas, tiba setelah bertahun-tahun tekanan dari pembuat undang-undang, kelompok kebebasan sipil, dan advokat hak-hak imigran yang lama berpendapat bahwa operasi ICE dilakukan dengan dokumentasi independen yang terlalu sedikit.

segments.src: According to agency statements, the initiative is meant to standardize how enforcement encounters are recorded, giving both officers and the public a consistent record of what happens during arrests, home visits, and transfers.
segments.tr: Menurut pernyataan agensi, inisiatif ini dimaksudkan untuk menstandarkan bagaimana pertemuan penegakan dicatat, memberikan kepada petugas dan publik rekam jejak yang konsisten tentang apa yang terjadi selama penangkapan, kunjungan rumah, dan transfer.

segments.src: Supporters of the plan, including some members of Congress who have pushed for expanded oversight of federal law enforcement, have welcomed the expansion as a step toward greater public trust.
segments.tr: Pendukung rencana, termasuk beberapa anggota Kongres yang telah mendorong pengawasan yang diperluas atas penegakan hukum federal, telah menyambut perluasan ini sebagai langkah menuju kepercayaan publik yang lebih besar.

segments.src: ## The Provision Drawing Scrutiny
segments.tr: ## Ketentuan yang Menarik Perhatian

segments.src: The rollout has not been without controversy.
segments.tr: Peluncuran ini tidak terlepas dari kontroversi.

segments.src: Under the policy as described by ICE, footage from incidents involving officer-involved shootings or deaths in custody is not automatically released to the public or to families.
segments.tr: Di bawah kebijakan seperti yang dijelaskan oleh ICE, cuplikan dari insiden yang melibatkan penembakan atau kematian petugas dalam tahanan tidak secara otomatis dirilis ke publik atau keluarga.

segments.src: Instead, agency leadership retains discretion over when — or whether — such footage is disclosed, a provision that can allow recordings to be withheld indefinitely while internal reviews are underway.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, kepemimpinan agensi mempertahankan kebebasan untuk memutuskan kapan — atau apakah — cuplikan tersebut diungkapkan, ketentuan yang dapat memungkinkan rekaman untuk ditahan tanpa batas waktu sementara tinjauan internal sedang berlangsung.

segments.src: That discretion has become the focal point of debate following two fatal encounters this summer, one in Maine and one in Houston, involving ICE personnel.
segments.tr: Kebebasan tersebut telah menjadi pusat perdebatan mengikuti dua pertemuan fatal musim ini, satu di Maine dan satu di Houston, yang melibatkan personel ICE.

segments.src: Details of both cases remain limited, and ICE has said that internal reviews are ongoing in accordance with standard procedure.
segments.tr: Detail kedua kasus tetap terbatas, dan ICE telah mengatakan bahwa tinjauan internal sedang berlangsung sesuai dengan prosedur standar.

segments.src: Family members and local advocacy organizations connected to the cases have called for the release of any existing body-camera footage, saying that timely disclosure is essential for public confidence in how such incidents are investigated.
segments.tr: Anggota keluarga dan organisasi advokasi lokal yang terkait dengan kasus telah menyerukan pelepasan cuplikan kamera tubuh yang ada, mengatakan bahwa pengungkapan tepat waktu penting bagi kepercayaan publik dalam bagaimana insiden tersebut diselidiki.

segments.src: Civil-liberties organizations, including groups that track use-of-force policies across federal agencies, argue that a body-camera program loses much of its accountability value if the agency being recorded also controls the release of the recordings.
segments.tr: Organisasi kebebasan sipil, termasuk kelompok yang melacak kebijakan penggunaan kekuatan di seluruh agensi federal, berpendapat bahwa program kamera tubuh kehilangan banyak nilai akuntabilitasnya jika agensi yang direkam juga mengendalikan pelepasan rekaman.

segments.src: "A camera that only the agency can choose to show us isn't oversight, it's a promise," one policy analyst focused on law-enforcement transparency told reporters, describing a concern echoed by several advocacy groups following the announcement.
segments.tr: "Kamera yang hanya dapat dipilih oleh agensi untuk ditampilkan kepada kami bukan pengawasan, itu adalah janji," seorang analis kebijakan yang fokus pada transparansi penegakan hukum mengatakan kepada para reporter, menggambarkan kekhawatiran yang bergema oleh beberapa kelompok advokasi setelah pengumuman tersebut.

segments.src: ## How ICE's Approach Compares
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Pendekatan ICE Dibandingkan

segments.src: Body-camera policies vary widely across federal, state, and local law enforcement.
segments.tr: Kebijakan kamera tubuh sangat bervariasi di seluruh penegakan hukum federal, negara bagian, dan lokal.

segments.src: Many police departments release footage of fatal encounters within a set number of days, sometimes under legal mandates passed after high-profile incidents involving other agencies.
segments.tr: Banyak departemen polisi melepaskan cuplikan pertemuan fatal dalam jumlah hari yang ditetapkan, kadang-kadang di bawah mandat hukum yang disahkan setelah insiden profil tinggi yang melibatkan agensi lain.

segments.src: Federal agencies, including ICE, generally operate under different rules, often citing ongoing investigations, personnel privacy, and pending litigation as reasons for withholding footage for extended periods.
segments.tr: Agensi federal, termasuk ICE, umumnya beroperasi di bawah aturan yang berbeda, sering mengutip penyelidikan yang sedang berlangsung, privasi personel, dan litigasi yang tertunda sebagai alasan untuk menahan cuplikan untuk periode yang diperpanjang.

segments.src: Department of Homeland Security officials, of which ICE is a component, have previously said that footage from significant incidents is reviewed internally before any public release to ensure accuracy and to avoid compromising active investigations.
segments.tr: Pejabat Departemen Keamanan Dalam Negeri, yang merupakan komponen ICE, sebelumnya telah mengatakan bahwa cuplikan dari insiden yang signifikan ditinjau secara internal sebelum rilis publik apa pun untuk memastikan akurasi dan menghindari membahayakan penyelidikan aktif.

segments.src: Officials have also noted that footage may ultimately be shared with oversight bodies, courts, or families through formal channels even when it is not made public immediately.
segments.tr: Para pejabat juga telah mencatat bahwa cuplikan pada akhirnya dapat dibagikan dengan badan pengawasan, pengadilan, atau keluarga melalui saluran formal bahkan ketika tidak diumumkan secara publik segera.

segments.src: ## What Advocates and Officials Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Diperhatikan Advokat dan Pejabat Selanjutnya

segments.src: Lawmakers on relevant congressional committees have signaled interest in questioning ICE leadership about the disclosure timeline for footage tied to the Maine and Houston cases, according to statements from congressional offices following the incidents.
segments.tr: Pembuat undang-undang di komite kongres yang relevan telah menunjukkan minat dalam mempertanyakan kepemimpinan ICE tentang garis waktu pengungkapan untuk cuplikan yang terikat pada kasus Maine dan Houston, menurut pernyataan dari kantor kongres setelah insiden tersebut.

segments.src: Whether that scrutiny leads to changes in the agency's release policy remains unclear.
segments.tr: Apakah pengawasan itu mengarah pada perubahan kebijakan rilis agensi tetap tidak jelas.

segments.src: For now, ICE maintains that the camera rollout itself represents progress, regardless of the ongoing debate over disclosure rules.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, ICE mempertahankan bahwa peluncuran kamera itu sendiri mewakili kemajuan, terlepas dari perdebatan yang sedang berlangsung tentang aturan pengungkapan.

segments.src: Agency officials have framed the expansion as one part of a broader modernization effort that also includes updated training and reporting requirements for field officers.
segments.tr: Pejabat agensi telah membingkai perluasan ini sebagai satu bagian dari upaya modernisasi yang lebih luas yang juga mencakup persyaratan pelatihan dan pelaporan yang diperbarui untuk petugas lapangan.

segments.src: Advocacy groups, meanwhile, say they will continue pressing for a binding timeline on footage release, arguing that cameras without a clear disclosure standard cannot fully deliver the accountability the program was designed to provide.
segments.tr: Kelompok advokasi, sementara itu, mengatakan bahwa mereka akan terus menekan untuk garis waktu pengungkapan yang mengikat, berpendapat bahwa kamera tanpa standar pengungkapan yang jelas tidak dapat sepenuhnya memberikan akuntabilitas yang dirancang oleh program untuk disediakan.

segments.src: As the end-of-August deadline approaches, both supporters and critics of the policy agree on one point: how ICE handles footage from future incidents, not just whether cameras are worn, will determine whether the rollout meaningfully changes public trust in the agency's operations.
segments.tr: Ketika tenggat waktu akhir Agustus mendekat, baik pendukung maupun kritikus kebijakan setuju pada satu poin: bagaimana ICE menangani cuplikan dari insiden di masa depan, bukan hanya apakah kamera dikenakan, akan menentukan apakah peluncuran ini secara bermakna mengubah kepercayaan publik dalam operasi agensi.

segments.src: *This report reflects publicly available statements from ICE, congressional offices, and advocacy organizations as of publication.
segments.tr: *Laporan ini mencerminkan pernyataan yang tersedia untuk umum dari ICE, kantor kongres, dan organisasi advokasi pada saat publikasi.

segments.src: Details of the Maine and Houston cases remain under review, and this article will be updated as verified information becomes available.*
segments.tr: Detail kasus Maine dan Houston tetap ditinjau, dan artikel ini akan diperbarui seiring dengan informasi yang terverifikasi menjadi tersedia.*

segments.tr: ## 次に擁護団体と関係者が注視していること
